name: House TDD
description: The design system for technical design documents built by the tdd skill and published as claude.ai HTML artifacts. White page (D2, Alec 2026-11-08), more colour and richer components than Notion (D3), one token set with a light and a dark value per colour. Text tokens hold at least 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes. Swatch tokens are the tldraw export colours, the same in both themes because the diagram plate stays light.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: page background (body): white, per D2

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: cards, tables, figures, dialogs

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: tinted panel: table head, rail buttons, the Today row, code

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: code blocks and inline code

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: body text (16.0:1 light, 14.3:1 dark on bg)

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: secondary text: captions, meta, summaries (5.9:1 light, 7.3:1 dark on bg)

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: hairlines, card and table borders

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: control edges, swatch default border (at least 3:1 on bg)

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: links, reference tokens, the Actual size button, focus ring

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: the title, active rail number, step numbers, DONE chips, decided-card edge

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: PROPOSED chips, violet callouts, the second legend hue

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: NEW and RECOMMENDED chips, good callouts, new steps

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: DRAFT and OPEN chips, open-card edge, warn callouts

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: HELD and BLOCKED chips, danger callouts, where-it-hurts

tokens.name: ruled
tokens.usage: RULED chip: solid ink, text in bg

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: diagram plate: light in both themes so tldraw strokes stay legible

tokens.name: plate-line
tokens.usage: plate border

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: letterbox behind video

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: dialog backdrop, enlarged shot backdrop

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: rail, popovers, dialogs, enlarged shots

tokens.name: sw-green
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: new or changed (tldraw green)

tokens.name: sw-green-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: new or changed

tokens.name: sw-grey
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: the app, existing context (tldraw grey)

tokens.name: sw-grey-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: the app

tokens.name: sw-blue
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: the engine or another system (tldraw blue)

tokens.name: sw-blue-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: the engine

tokens.name: sw-amber
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: needs a data source (tldraw yellow)

tokens.name: sw-amber-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: needs a data source

tokens.name: sw-red
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: where it hurts (tldraw red)

tokens.name: sw-red-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: where it hurts

tokens.name: sw-orange-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: proposed engine change (dashed orange)

tokens.name: sw-violet
tokens.usage: legend swatch fill: flagged or secondary (tldraw violet)

tokens.name: sw-violet-line
tokens.usage: legend swatch stroke: flagged or secondary

display.usage: h1, h2, h3, card and decision titles (one family with the body, as the reference page: Notion-like)

mono.usage: code, path:line citations, D-numbers, PR numbers

layout.gutter: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left/right, 0px)); the rail side adds 76px at >= 900px
